第(1/3)页

“说吧，你到底是怎么发现操场埋的骷髅架的。”

单独的审讯室

陆云铮穿着制服，坐在黎雾对面，面色严肃的开口询问。

头顶是一晃一晃的灯光。

墙面是冷色调。

无形的心理压力涌上心头。

黎雾只觉得一股冷意从骨头缝里冒出来。

没有想到这就是陆云铮说的谈一谈，这是完全把她当犯人审。

犹豫一二之后，开口道：

“我视力比较好，看见他们两个偷偷摸摸抬骷髅架子离开。”

“感觉有点不对，第一时间就报警了。”

“细究起来，我也没什么问题吧。”

黎雾问得忐忑。

陆云铮微微颔首，抬手不知道在记录本上写了什么东西。

冷硬的嗓音响起：

“没问题。”

“不仅没问题，你还是大功臣。”

“要不是你发现不对，这具尸体被张涛和王大强两人成功转移，将再也不会有重见天日的那天。”

黎雾闻言轻舒了一口气。

气才吐到一半，就听到陆云铮的声音一转：

“但是……”

陆云铮抬手屈指，指尖在桌面上轻敲，发出砰砰砰极其富有节奏感的声调。

男人不缓不急充满压迫力的声音响起：

“徐倩文绑架案，幸福小苑5栋6楼灭门案，还有今天的操场埋尸案。”

“短短三天，三个案件。”

陆云铮陡然抬眸，目光凌厉的看向黎雾：

“黎雾，你不觉得，这太巧合了吗？”

“为什么你能这么精准的在人群中识别到犯罪的凶手？”

这是陆云铮在第一次见到黎雾时，就升起的古怪感。

从徐倩文绑架案时，黎雾不假思索的让他们去抓捕刀疤脸的时候，他就觉得很奇怪。

他叫人去查过黎雾的资料，甚至于仔细观看了黎雾在徐倩文被绑架前后的踪迹。

最后发现这人就是一个实实在在的社恐，除了出门上学，就是呆在家里。

那她到底是怎么发现刀疤脸有问题的。

陆云铮想不通。

但是他想不通的事实在是太多了，只要确定黎雾没有问题，不是凶手就行。

"Tell me, how did you find the skeleton buried in the playground?"

separate interrogation room

Lu Yunzheng was wearing uniform, sitting opposite Li Wu, and asked with a serious face.

Overhead was a flickering light.

The walls are in cool colors.

Invisible psychological pressure surged into my heart.

Li Wu felt a chill coming from the cracks in his bones.

Unexpectedly, this was what Lu Yunzheng said, and he was trying her completely as a prisoner.

After hesitating for a moment or two, he said:

"My eyesight is relatively good, and I saw the two of them sneaking away carrying the skeleton."

"I felt something was wrong, so I called the police immediately."

"Looking closely, I don't have any problems."

Li Wu asked anxiously.

Lu Yunzheng nodded slightly, raised his hand and wrote something in the notebook.

A cold and hard voice sounded:

"No problem."

"Not only is there no problem, you are also a great contributor."

"If you hadn't discovered something was wrong, this body would have been successfully transferred by Zhang Tao and Wang Daqiang, and it would never have seen the light of day again."

Li Wu breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this.

He was halfway through breathing when he heard Lu Yunzheng's voice:

"But..."

Lu Yunzheng raised his hand and tapped his fingers on the table, making an extremely rhythmic sound.

The man's unhurried and oppressive voice sounded:

"Xu Qianwen's kidnapping case, the murder case on the 6th floor of Building 5 of Xingfu Xiaoyuan, and today's corpse burial case in the playground."

"Three cases in just three days."

Lu Yunzheng suddenly raised his eyes and looked at Li Wu sharply:

"Li Wu, don't you think this is too coincidental?"

"Why can you identify the perpetrator of a crime so accurately among the crowd?"

This was the strange feeling that arose in Lu Yunzheng when he saw Li Wu for the first time.

Ever since the Xu Qianwen kidnapping case, when Li Wu asked them to arrest Scarface without hesitation, he felt strange.

He asked people to check Li Wu's information, and even carefully watched Li Wu's whereabouts before and after Xu Qianwen was kidnapped.

In the end, I found out that this person is a real social fear. Except when he goes out to school, he just stays at home.

So how on earth did she discover that there was something wrong with Scarface.

Lu Yunzheng couldn't figure it out.

But there were too many facts that he couldn't figure out. As long as he was sure that Li Wu had no problem and was not the murderer.
